responsibility: Implements pretty-printing and dumping of GIMPLE statements, sequences, PHIs, and basic blocks for dumps, debugging, and graph output. It formats individual statement kinds, implicit CFG edges, profile/count metadata, SSA and range-related annotations, and block-level structure, serving as the main textual rendering layer for GIMPLE IR diagnostics and dump files.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual rendering of GIMPLE statements, sequences, PHIs, CFG edges, and basic blocks for dumps/debug output, whereas the header only declares the printing and debugging entry points.
